name: browser-context-diagnostics
goal: Capture each console error and uncaught exception before and after popup page availability, without duplicate diagnostics or browser startup for API tests

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: CI job 117504616589 and the unchanged two-worker local E2E both reported popup navigation error as expected success at 6abda8f8. The collector from 776e98aa attaches only after context page availability, after an initial script may run.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing generated-browser coverage includes popup navigation but macOS timing had hidden its failure. Missing deterministic lifecycle inputs: context console/weberror before page announcement and overlapping context/page delivery. Strengthen existing browser-console unit/E2E and host-capture coverage; retain template parity and API-only lazy startup checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: At unchanged product 6abda8f8, bun x vitest run test/browser-console-errors.test.ts test/host-capture-errors.test.ts failed both early lifecycle cases: expected initial document failed plus later script failed; received only later script failed. Real generated-popup E2E also fails in CI and the full local two-worker run.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Observe BrowserContext console and weberror before navigation, using each event page for provenance; remove page observers to avoid duplicate delivery. Keep generated fixture parity and lazy setup. Strengthen the existing browser-fixture acceptance rule with deterministic pre-page and overlapping-event lifecycle coverage in normal unit verification.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Shared and generated fixtures now subscribe to BrowserContext console/weberror directly; no per-page observer can attach too late or double-count. Existing unit, real generated popup/exception, expected-error and API-only cases cover the lifecycle. The existing shared-fixture acceptance rule now requires pre-page and overlapping-event coverage.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged lifecycle assertions passed after repair. bun x vitest run test/browser-console-errors.test.ts test/host-capture-errors.test.ts test/browser-console-errors.e2e.test.ts test/browser-console-expected.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers 2 passed all 10 tests, including popup console/exception, exact expected diagnostics and API-only unavailable-browser behavior.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Copied the frozen lifecycle test into an isolated temporary workspace. Restoring only the collector from 6abda8f8 caused both pre-page assertions to fail on missing initial document failed; replacing only that fixture with the repair passed both tests. Guard logs retained under ignored .cache/browser-error-evidence. The initial Bun-hosted harness bootstrap error was excluded; proof used the normal Node Vitest runner.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
